experiment: Cross-system validation: MemStrata rules applied to MemTether data
method: Extracted (S,R,O) triples from 2635 records, applied MemStrata deterministic supersession rule chronologically

entity_grounding_effect.conclusion: Entity grounding effect is system-specific, not universal

implication: Findings from one memory system may not generalize to others. Cross-system validation is necessary before claiming universal properties.
